root_cause.text: The `squashfs_read_metadata` function in `fs/squashfs/cache.c` fails to validate that the metadata block offset is within the valid range (non-negative and less than `SQUASHFS_METADATA_SIZE`), allowing a corrupted index look-up table to pass a negative offset and cause an out-of-bounds access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (unlikely(*offset < 0 || *offset >= SQUASHFS_METADATA_SIZE))` to `squashfs_read_metadata` to prevent a negative offset from being passed to `squashfs_copy_data`, which the commit message states causes a general protection fault due to an out-of-bounds access.

bic_trace_step.reason: The function `squashfs_read_metadata` only checks if `*offset >= entry->length` (line 351) but does not validate if `*offset` is negative. If a negative offset is passed, this check is bypassed, and the negative offset is passed to `squashfs_copy_data` (line 354). In `squashfs_copy_data`, the negative offset is used in array indexing `entry->data[offset / PAGE_CACHE_SIZE]` (line 313), leading to an out-of-bounds memory access.
